list.source: select "file_documents"."cantrip_os_binding_id", "file_documents"."os_binding_generation", "file_documents"."os_attachment_generation", "file_documents"."os_runtime_generation", "file_documents"."id", "file_documents"."project_id", "file_documents"."worker_id", "file_documents"."worktree_id", "file_documents"."protected_state", "file_documents"."created_at" from "file_documents" inner join "projects" on ("projects"."id" = "file_documents"."project_id" and "projects"."owner_id" = $1) where "file_documents"."project_id" = $2 order by "file_documents"."created_at" asc, "file_documents"."id" asc

get.source: select "file_documents"."cantrip_os_binding_id", "file_documents"."os_binding_generation", "file_documents"."os_attachment_generation", "file_documents"."os_runtime_generation", "file_documents"."id", "file_documents"."project_id", "file_documents"."worker_id", "file_documents"."worktree_id", "file_documents"."protected_state", "file_documents"."created_at" from "file_documents" inner join "projects" on ("projects"."id" = "file_documents"."project_id" and "projects"."owner_id" = $1) where "file_documents"."id" = $2

target.source: select "project_worktrees"."worker_id" from "project_worktrees" inner join "project_sources" on "project_sources"."id" = "project_worktrees"."project_source_id" inner join "projects" on "projects"."id" = "project_sources"."project_id" inner join "workers" on "workers"."id" = "project_worktrees"."worker_id" where ("projects"."owner_id" = $1 and "workers"."owner_id" = $2 and "workers"."unlinked_at" is null and "projects"."id" = $3 and "project_worktrees"."id" = $4 and "project_worktrees"."lifecycle_state" = $5 and "project_sources"."removed_at" is null) for update

insert.source: insert into "file_documents" ("cantrip_os_binding_id", "os_binding_generation", "os_attachment_generation", "os_runtime_generation", "id", "project_id", "worker_id", "worktree_id", "protected_state", "created_at") values (default, default, default, default, $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, default) on conflict do nothing returning "cantrip_os_binding_id", "os_binding_generation", "os_attachment_generation", "os_runtime_generation", "id", "project_id", "worker_id", "worktree_id", "protected_state", "created_at"

context.source: select "file_documents"."cantrip_os_binding_id", "file_documents"."os_binding_generation", "file_documents"."os_attachment_generation", "file_documents"."os_runtime_generation", "file_documents"."id", "file_documents"."project_id", "file_documents"."worker_id", "file_documents"."worktree_id", "file_documents"."protected_state", "file_documents"."created_at", "project_worktrees"."id", "project_worktrees"."project_source_id", "project_worktrees"."worker_id", "project_worktrees"."root_kind", "project_worktrees"."name", "project_worktrees"."location_kind", "project_worktrees"."absolute_path", "project_worktrees"."guest_path", "project_worktrees"."display_path", "project_worktrees"."is_primary", "project_worktrees"."is_default", "project_worktrees"."origin", "project_worktrees"."lifecycle_state", "project_worktrees"."branch", "project_worktrees"."head", "project_worktrees"."detached", "project_worktrees"."locked", "project_worktrees"."lock_reason", "project_worktrees"."status_snapshot", "project_worktrees"."status_observed_at", "project_worktrees"."last_scanned_at", "project_worktrees"."created_at", "project_worktrees"."updated_at" from "file_documents" inner join "projects" on ("projects"."id" = "file_documents"."project_id" and "projects"."owner_id" = $1) inner join "project_worktrees" on ("project_worktrees"."id" = "file_documents"."worktree_id" and "project_worktrees"."worker_id" = "file_documents"."worker_id" and "project_worktrees"."lifecycle_state" = $2) inner join "project_source_identities" on ("project_source_identities"."id" = "project_worktrees"."project_source_id" and "project_source_identities"."project_id" = "file_documents"."project_id") left join "project_sources" on "project_sources"."id" = "project_worktrees"."project_source_id" inner join "workers" on ("workers"."id" = "file_documents"."worker_id" and "workers"."owner_id" = $3 and "workers"."unlinked_at" is null) where ("file_documents"."id" = $4 and ("project_worktrees"."location_kind" = $5 or ("project_sources"."id" is not null and "project_sources"."removed_at" is null)))
